It then calculates `float3 ab = normalize(tri.b - tri.a)`, `float3 bc = normalize(tri.c - tri.b)`, and `float3 ca = normalize(tri.a - tri.c)`, which corresponds to normalizing the edge vectors. Finally, the code checks intersection against 15 specific axes: 9 cross products of the normalized edges with the X, Y, and Z axes (a00-a22), the 3 X/Y/Z axes themselves, and the triangle's normal (`cross(ab, bc)`).
